_about: Hand-kept facts the Bungie API doesn't carry, for the wiki's destination pages (checked October 2026). Which public events run where: Bungie's own triumph text where it names one (bungie: true), otherwise community guides. Heroic triggers and lost sector entrances: community guides (Shacknews, GamesRadar, blueberries.gg, Destinypedia, ProGameTalk). Distortions, jobs and the other activities: Bungie's Monument of Triumph articles, 9.7.0 patch notes, Lawless Frontier guide and triumphs.

events.Glimmer Extraction: Each phase spawns a Glimmer refiner near the drill site. Destroy all three before the event ends.
events.Injection Rig: Kill the Elite Psion that spawns, then destroy the vents it opens on the rig.
events.Cabal Excavation: Once the drill is about a third done, a Thresher flies over. Shoot it down and a Cabal boss spawns.
events.Ether Resupply: Partway through, three small Servitors appear next to the big one. Kill all three quickly, before they leave.
events.Taken Blight: Step into one of the small blights on the ground to get Blight Receding, then shoot the big Blight in the sky while it lasts. Enough damage spawns the Blightmaker.
events.Fallen Walker: Break one of the Walker's legs so it drops Arc charges, and dunk them into the receivers on the shields. A second Walker drops in; destroy both before time runs out.
events.Spire Integration: Before the timer reaches 1:00, stand on the three Vex plates around the spire until each is captured. Follow the white data lines out of the spire to find them.
events.Crux Convergence: Destroy the three scanner drones flying around each Darkness Crux.
events.Rift Generator: After each wave a Blight appears over the water. Destroy it all three times, then kill the Wizards around the giant Blight to reach the Ascendant Realm and its Taken boss.
events.Ether Harvest: Shoot down every Ether cloud before it reaches the harvester, wave after wave.
events.Hive Ritual: Stand on the plates to drop the Wizards' shields, kill both Wizards, then destroy the two crystals above the portal.
events.Resonant Destruction: Scorn drop orange orbs. Throw five of them into the escorted pyramid before the event ends.

distortions: One of the seven destinations is distorted for an hour; the Destinations screen shows which one and the time left. Enemies are tougher and the sky turns red.
Public events drop one gear tier higher than usual: Tier 4 for a normal clear and Tier 5 for a Heroic one.
Distortion-only events with their own weapon set.
Can open after a public event finishes on a distorted destination.
Hidden caches to open, and an extradimensional signal whose rough location is marked on your map.
Collectibles scattered around each distorted destination, for a Monument of Triumph triumph.

also: Grab an Interceptor and run over combatants anywhere in the EDZ (a Monument of Triumph triumph).
Fallen Spider Tanks roam anywhere in the Cosmodrome.
A named Fallen target in the Forgotten Shore.
Disturb the remains in Skywatch, then defeat the remnants of the past that show up.
Repeatable wave defense near the Scarlet Keep; drops tiered loot since Monument of Triumph.
Score or watch a perfect round of the tire game.
Roaming Vex-converted enemies to hunt down.
Pick them up in the Ancient's Haunt and use them on combatants.
Hunt one of Eramis's lieutenants: The Technocrat, The Warrior or The Dark Priestess.
Wave defense in the Divalian Mists; drops tiered loot since Monument of Triumph.
Open them with Tincture of Queensfoil.
Attack and Defend versions, launched from the Throne World.
Four memory missions entered from inside the Throne World.
A hidden chest in the Queen's Bailey.
A zone takeover that moves around Neomuna. It drops tiered loot, and once you have every crafting pattern its weapons drop from more places too.
A Vex-held part of Neomuna with its own public events and Strand sources to harness.
Platforming event in the Landing, the Lost City and the Blooming.
Demolition event in the Landing, the Impasse and the Transgression.
Event in the Seclusion and the Impasse.
A zone event that only runs at certain times of day. Bungie names it, with Time Latch missions, as the best source of higher-tier Kepler gear.
The playlist with the best odds at higher-tier Kepler gear.
Pick a job on the Holomap: a mix of destination, Syndicate and job type (Sabotage, Bounty Hunt or Smuggle).
Raising a job's difficulty raises the gear tier it can drop, and higher difficulties hide more chests.
Reach the exfil point at the end, with the whole fireteam if you can. Some loot only counts if you exfil with it.
Jobs with a yellow frame are invadable: at Master or Grandmaster another player may invade you, and surviving gives better loot.
Xûr's game show, launched from Eternity.
